name: Chiseled Enchanting Table (Unofficial 26.2 Port)
description: Unofficial community port of Sacramentix's Chiseled Enchanting Table to Minecraft 26.2 / Fabric. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the original author. A rework of enchantment progression: you can now enchant your gear using enchanted books placed in nearby chiseled bookshelves using a chiseled enchanting table.

custom.chiseled_enchanting_table:port_notes: Unofficial community port to Minecraft 26.2. 1.0.2 stable: JSON-driven chest / archaeology loot injection, live structure bookshelf replacement/fill, score-based shelf-facing, vanilla-anvil-style XP point deduction, restored vanilla enchanting-table book blocking, restored narrow anvil book+book same-level merge blocking, and restored enchanted-book chiseled-bookshelf random-tick particles/sound. Active mixins live in chiseled-enchanting-table-port.mixins.json. Still parked: broader anvil XP-cost tweak, Colorful Books integration, enchanted-book stack-size accessor, and remaining visual/advancement polish. See CURRENT_BASELINE.md for the full capability boundary and docs/EXTENDING.md for data-driven customisation entry points.
